note.windows: Needs your own CarnEvil v1.0.1 files (MAME's carnevil1): carnevil1_9.u32 and sound102.u95, loose or in the zip, and the disk carnevi1.chd. The first build takes 15 to 30 minutes and about 2 GB; Git, Python, CMake and the Visual Studio Build Tools (about 3 GB) are installed if they are missing.
